title: Kuzenler

characters.COUSIN1: a girl of about nine with two brown braids, wearing a red cardigan
characters.COUSIN2: a boy of about ten with curly black hair, wearing a green sweater
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty-five with long brown hair in a braid, wearing a red dress
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-five with curly black hair, wearing a dark green suit

scenes.text:
Çocukken bayramları asıl özel yapan neydi,
hatırlıyor musun?
scenes.prompt: A big old family house with a garden at sunset, all its windows glowing warmly, autumn trees with golden leaves falling around it. No people visible.

scenes.text:
Kalabalık bir ev,
yer yataklarında fısıldaşan kuzenler.
scenes.prompt: At night in a room lit by a small lamp, {COUSIN1} on the left and {COUSIN2} on the right lie on floor mattresses under thick quilts, whispering and giggling.

scenes.text:
Bahçede saklambaç,
gece yarısına kadar süren kahkahalar.
scenes.prompt: In the garden of the old house at dusk, {COUSIN2} hides behind a big tree giggling, while {COUSIN1} on the left leans against another tree covering her eyes and counting, autumn leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Şimdi sadece düğünlerde görüşüp
"Hiç değişmemişsin" deyip ayrılıyorsunuz.
scenes.prompt: At an evening garden wedding under strings of warm lights, {WOMAN} on the left and {MAN} on the right stand facing each other with polite, slightly shy smiles.

scenes.text:
Bir düğün beklemeden kuzenlerini topla.
Bunu kuzen grubuna gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {WOMAN} and {MAN} sit side by side on the front steps of the old family house laughing together, golden autumn leaves falling around them.

caption:
Kuzenlerin nerede?

Çocukluğun en kalabalık yeri onlardı. 🤍

Bunu kuzen grubuna gönder.
